errors.text_span: подредени в азбучен ред по реда на събитията
errors.evidence: The description claims the dates are ordered alphabetically ('азбучен ред'), which is incorrect. They are ordered chronologically. The phrase is also self-contradictory and confusing.
The y-axis is not labeled. 'Валеж (l/m²)' is the title of the chart.
The bar for 3/7/2024 is visibly above the 10.00 line, at approximately 10.7 l/m².

errors.text_span: най-ниските стълби са за 3/3/2024, 3/5/2024 и 3/15/2024 с височина 0.00 l/m²
errors.evidence: The bar for 3/3/2024 is not at 0.00; it represents a small but non-zero value (approximately 0.2). The description also omits other dates with zero precipitation, such as 3/4/2024, 3/8/2024, 3/9/2024 and 3/10/2024.

errors.text_span: и всички са изобразени с еднаква толерантност
errors.evidence: The phrase 'с еднаква толерантност' (with equal tolerance) is awkward and unclear in this context, likely intending to say the bars have uniform width, but it harms readability.

errors.text_span: и не е предназначена за сравнение между категории
errors.evidence: A primary purpose of a bar chart is to allow for comparison between categories. Stating that it is 'not intended for comparison' is an incorrect and subjective interpretation of the chart's function.
